validation_performed.TrainerAvatar: Imports `Image as ExpoImage` from 'expo-image' (package.json: expo-image ~3.0.11 present). Renders <ExpoImage source={uri} cachePolicy='memory-disk' contentFit='cover' transition={120} recyclingKey={uri} /> when uri is a string; falls back to initials disc otherwise. Pulse halo Animated.loop intact and gated by `pulse` prop. ESLint clean. The source={uri} signature is valid for expo-image v3 which accepts a string URI directly.
validation_performed.AccentGlowOverlay: Imports AppState from 'react-native'. useState(appActive) initialized from AppState.currentState==='active'. AppState 'change' subscriber updates appActive and is properly cleaned up via sub.remove(). The breathing Animated.loop only starts when appActive; otherwise pulse.stopAnimation() is invoked. Loop cleanup via loop.stop() in effect teardown. Early-returns for !user and intensity<=0.001 unchanged. ESLint clean.
validation_performed.FloatingOrangeBg: Imports AppState. FloatingOrangeBg holds `paused` state from AppState.currentState !== 'active' (note: this is INVERTED — paused=true when NOT active — correct). 'change' listener flips paused on transitions. Each Ember receives `paused` as a prop; Ember's loop effect early-returns when paused and stops the loop on unmount via loop.stop(). useMemo dependency only on density (correct, prevents per-render ember recreation). ESLint clean.
validation_performed.web_preview_gate: Root URL and /auth/login both serve the stale 'Welcome to Expo' placeholder from /app/frontend/dist/ as documented in the review request agent-to-agent note. Zero pageerrors, zero console errors, no red error screen, no WSOD, no JS bundling error. Confirmed pre-existing pod limitation (stale static export), not a regression caused by this changeset. Expo Metro dev-server logs show only ngrok-tunnel errors (env limitation), no 'Unable to resolve module' or 'image source unresolvable' errors.

critical_code_review_comments: TrainerAvatar.tsx L101 — `source={uri}` where uri is `string | null | undefined`. The truthiness guard at L99 (`{uri ? ... : ...}`) ensures only a non-empty string reaches ExpoImage, but the prop typing on expo-image is `ImageSource | ImageSource[] | string | string[] | number | null`. Safe today; consider `source={{ uri }}` (object form) if you ever need to pass headers/cacheKey explicitly.

AccentGlowOverlay.tsx L47-49 — when appActive flips false, the code calls pulse.stopAnimation() but does NOT reset to a known baseline value. Comment claims 'Reset to a stable mid-value' but no setValue is called. The pulse `opacity` will freeze at whatever interpolated value it was at when stopped. This is cosmetic only (Animated.Value retains its last value), but the comment is misleading. Suggest adding `pulse.setValue(0.7)` to match the initial useRef value, or remove the misleading comment.

FloatingOrangeBg.tsx L51 — eslint-disable for react-hooks/exhaustive-deps drops `delay/duration/intensity/y/opacity` from the dep array. delay/duration/intensity are stable per-Ember (memoized in parent), and y/opacity are refs (stable). Safe.

FloatingOrangeBg.tsx L52 — Ember's useEffect depends on `paused`, so when paused flips from false->true the cleanup runs and stops the loop. When paused flips true->false, the loop is re-created from scratch starting with Animated.delay(delay). This means every ember restarts in phase after a foreground resume, which may produce a brief synchronized 'pulse' instead of the staggered ambience. Minor visual nit, not a regression — embers were also restarted on every prop change before this patch.

TrainerAvatar.tsx — the `pulse` prop default is `true`. The component is mounted on map markers, list rows, and chat rows. With many simultaneous mounts (e.g., a 20-trainer Discovery list), each one runs its own JS-driven Animated.loop. expo-image fixes the IMAGE memory, but the per-marker pulse loops still allocate JS-thread state. Consider passing `pulse={false}` on dense list/map views to amplify the memory win, OR gating pulse with AppState the same way AccentGlowOverlay and FloatingOrangeBg now do.

rca of the issue: No bug found. The iter106am fix set is structurally correct: (a) the three background assets are now true JPEGs at ~90KB each (down from ~620KB PNGs, eliminating ~1.6MB of decoded-image RAM across the home/saved/map list screens that mount them), (b) TrainerAvatar correctly delegates to expo-image's SDWebImage(iOS)/Coil(Android) backed cache with memory-disk policy and recyclingKey for LRU eviction, removing the primary RN <Image> memory pin during map/list scrolls, and (c) both ambient overlays (AccentGlowOverlay's breathing pulse, FloatingOrangeBg's 8 embers) now stop their Animated.loops while AppState !== 'active', eliminating background CPU + main-thread reconciliation work that contributed to the iOS jetsam pressure. All three vectors named in the Sentry WatchdogTermination RCA are addressed and the implementation passes lint + code review.
